g.text: Source: handbook-§13.3 — ns3::CobaltQueueDisc on the 10 Mbps x 5 ms RFC-7928 dumbbell. Well-configured Cobalt keeps mean delay 2-15 ms across 50-100% load; tail (P99) below 30 ms. Values outside this range indicate misconfigured target or unexpectedly deep queues.
